tissues.label: Chorion
tissues.why: The only structure the atlas draws from 0 hpf, and it encloses every other one, so the movie opens on a green shell and loses it at hatching.

tissues.label: Yolk syncytial layer
tissues.why: A bright solid sphere at mid-body that shrinks as the yolk is consumed, and the only member of the ranked eight that is lit before 10 hpf.

tissues.label: Enveloping layer
tissues.why: The outer epithelium of the blastoderm, a dome that spreads over the yolk through epiboly and is the only record that shows epiboly as motion.

tissues.label: Germ ring
tissues.why: A narrow band at the blastoderm margin that sweeps down the yolk; the aspect ratio of 9 to 1 is unlike any other early record.

tissues.label: Notochord
tissues.why: One smooth tapering rod on the midline for the whole window, and the reference every other axial tissue is read against.

tissues.label: Hatching gland
tissues.why: A single oval on the dorsal yolk that no other record sits near, and it covers the 10 to 24 hpf part of the series.

tissues.label: Myotome
tissues.why: The largest lit area of any candidate and the only repeating chevron series; segmentation is legible frame by frame.

tissues.label: Eye
tissues.why: One saturated disc at the extreme anterior; the highest fill of the set at 0.80 and the only structure that far forward.

tissues.label: Brain
tissues.why: The whole brain family as one lobed mass in the head vault, so the movie shows the divisions appearing rather than one of them.

tissues.label: Lateral line system
tissues.why: A migrating primordium that resolves into evenly spaced neuromasts; the only regular row of separate dots.

tissues.label: Pronephros
tissues.why: The paired duct and tubule as a long thin pair high in the trunk, the only entry for the renal system.

tissues.label: Gut
tissues.why: The rod resolves into the oesophagus, the bulb and the intestine over the window, so one movie carries the whole gut tube.

tissues.label: Pharyngeal arch
tissues.why: A chain of beads under the head that grows from one to seven; no other candidate is a short row of solid blocks.

tissues.label: Intermediate cell mass of mesoderm
tissues.why: The only hematopoietic record with a window in this range; a broken band between the somites and the yolk at 24 hpf.

tissues.label: Otic vesicle
tissues.why: A small solid circle behind the eye that grows and elongates; the only entry for the vestibuloauditory system.

tissues.label: Heart
tissues.why: A compact mass under the head that loops and splits into chambers at 42 hpf, all inside the window.

tissues.label: Trunk vasculature
tissues.why: Two long parallel trunks with a ladder of intersegmental rungs between them; 15 separate pieces and the only lattice.

tissues.label: Spinal cord
tissues.why: A rod dorsal to the notochord, the trunk half of the central nervous system the brain entry leaves out.

tissues.label: Median fin fold
tissues.why: A long lens-shaped outline around the tail; it overlaps no other member of the ranked eight by more than 0.01.

tissues.label: Pigment cell
tissues.why: Melanophores then xanthophores and iridophores as 128 separate spots over the whole body; the only stipple pattern.
